svg.title: Valley Ridge final turn and grandstand clearance
svg.desc: Matched overhead plans from the production track. The 64 metre terrace used to cover 15.75 metres of racing lane. Its new position shifts 30 metres along the straight and clears the physical boundary by 4.65 metres.

g.text: 15.75 m of racing lane under the terrace
4.65 m beyond the nearest physical track boundary
